1.e4 c5 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3.strategy: The natural developing move: the knight controls d5, supports the e4 pawn and adds to the grip of the pawns on c4 and e4 on the centre. White plays for a slow positional game with more space.

1.e4 c5 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 Nc6.strategy: Develops a piece against the centre and keeps an eye on d4 and e5 without weakening anything. Black accepts a solid but slightly cramped position and waits for White to commit before choosing a set-up.
